decisions.statement: The folder is named the plural one or more page types gather their pages under.
A folder named no page type's plural is refused before anything else is read.
A page type that plural covers is one of those page types or a page type extending one.
Every subfolder is named for a page type that plural covers.
A subfolder is named for a page type whose own plural is that subfolder's name.
A subfolder is named for a page type whose slug is that subfolder's name.
A subfolder is named for a page type whose slug ends with `-` and that subfolder's name.
The folder holds no page of its own.
A folder gathering nothing is refused.
What a subfolder holds is judged where that subfolder is.

definition: the shape of a folder gathering under a plural the page types that plural covers
